intro: The Crest of Lordaeron is a weathered relic bearing the regal mark of the fallen northern kingdom. Found amidst the desolate ruins of Capital City, such relics are scarce since the kingdom's fall, and someone in Stormwind would be very keen to get their hands on this one.
